Shipping Policy

Shipping Policy

Free shipping on every bubble mailer order to any US address. Plain stock leaves within 4-6 business days and arrives 2-3 business days later, with tracking by email.

Contact UsView Products

A bubble mailer order is only useful once it is on your packing bench, so this page sets out exactly how it gets there: what shipping costs, where we deliver, how long each stage takes, and what happens if a carton arrives in poor shape. The same figures appear on every product page, at checkout and on your order confirmation.

What shipping costs

Shipping is free on every order to any address in the United States. That covers a single case of 250 mailers and a full pallet alike, plain stock and custom printed runs alike. The total at checkout is the delivered total, and nothing is added when the order ships.

Where we deliver

We ship to US addresses only. Businesses, warehouses, fulfillment centers and home offices are all fine. We do not ship outside the United States.

How long it takes

  • Plain stock: leaves us within 4-6 business days of your order, then 2-3 business days in transit. Shipping is free.
  • Custom printed: production time is confirmed on your quote and counted from proof approval; the packed run then ships free and spends 2-3 business days in transit.

Business days run Monday to Friday and exclude US federal holidays. An order placed at the weekend starts on the next business day.

Tracking

When the order leaves, we email the tracking number to the address you used at checkout. If it has not reached you within two business days of dispatch, reply to that email or call us and we will chase the carrier.

Pallet programs and scheduled releases

Large printed runs can be released on a schedule at no extra shipping cost, so you can buy at the pallet price without storing the pallet. Agree the release plan on your quote and each release ships free on the same transit time.

Address changes and missed deliveries

You can change the delivery address free of charge until the order ships. After that we can only ask the carrier to redirect it. If a delivery is missed, the carrier leaves a notice; if the parcel comes back to us, we resend it to a corrected US address at no cost.

Damaged or short deliveries

Check the cartons when they arrive. If anything is damaged or short, photograph it and contact us within 14 days of delivery. We arranged the shipment, so putting it right is our job: see our returns and refunds policy for how replacements and refunds work.
